keywords: Counseling 2.Truant and Bullying 3.Developmental Disorder 4.Developmental Counseling 5.Cooperation between School and Community
educationalGoal: This course covers psychological problems in secondary school(relationship between students and parents, truant, bullying, school maladjustment, developmental disorder, and so on). Students will discuss psychological features in adolescence, relationship between teachers and students, and relationship between teachers and parents, and aim to acquire the correct view and skill for students with school maladjustment.
advice: This course includes the following materials: (1) To consider the current issues of school maladjustment in secondary education(truant, bullying, and school maladjustment) (2) To understand psychological features and psychological problems in adolescence, and the support system for students with school maladjustment (3) To understand basic theories of school counseling and psychological support for students with school maladjustment. Students are expected to consider what is necessary for secondary school students.
books: Textbooks:Yoku Wakaru Kyouiku-Soudan, Mineruva shobou Reference books:None Reserved books:None
requiredKnowledge: To understand basic knowledge of educational psychology.

activityGoals.body: Be able to answer the space filling and descriptive questions about truant, bullying, and school maladjustment.
Be able to explain how to understand secondary school students with psychological problems.
Be able to explain the correct psychological support for secondary school students.
Be able to engage in this course and self-evaluate objectives of this course to be achieved.
